caption: The drawing contains a detailed illustration and technical schematics of a wooden cradle. The upper part of the image shows a colored perspective view of the cradle, which is brown in color, featuring two curved rockers as its base, upright side panels with cutout handles, and shorter end panels, one of which curves upward. The cradle's body is rectangular with the longer sides bounded by the shorter end panels. Below the colored illustration are two black-and-white technical drawings: a front view on the left and a side view on the right. The front view depicts the width of the cradle, the curvature of the rockers at the base, the width at the top, the placement and size of cutout handle, and specifies measurements such as 27 inches total width and 17 1/2 inches panel width. The side view details the cradle's length, rocker shape, panel heights, interior dimensions, and more specific measurements such as 40 1/2 inches overall length, 15 inches height for the higher end, and 12 inches for the lower side. Both technical views are accompanied by scaled notations specifying "scale 3/16 to the inch" for the perspective drawing and "scale 3/32 to the inch" for the technical schematic views. The drawing uses a plain, cream-colored background with dark ink for measurements and outlines, and a natural wood tone for the colored perspective illustration.
title: Bishop Hill: Cradle
